features.title: Menu viewer
features.summary: menu-viewer shows catalog, cart, and guest flows; ties to SubmitMenuOrder.
features.content:
## MenuViewerComponent

Public menu experience for scanned menu QRs. May call `GetQRPublic`, shop/product public endpoints, and `SubmitMenuOrder` for checkout. **menu viewer** is the primary UX surface for food & beverage use cases.

features.title: Loyalty viewer
features.summary: Registration, stamp card, and rewards for loyalty-program QRs.
features.content:
## LoyaltyViewerComponent

Uses `RegisterForLoyalty`, `CheckLoyaltyRegistration`, prize and redemption endpoints. See loyalty domain for admin APIs.

features.title: Website viewer
features.summary: Opens external or embedded web content from QR payload.
features.content:
## WebsiteViewerComponent

Resolves URL from content JSON; may track ScanQR for analytics.

features.title: Content system viewer
features.summary: Renders multi-section content QR (hero, promos, parking).
features.content:
## ContentViewerComponent

Maps JSON sections to layout blocks; shares design tokens with editor tabs.

features.title: Event viewer
features.summary: Registration UI with RegisterForEvent and CheckEventRegistration.
features.content:
## EventViewerComponent

Handles signup forms and status display for event QRs.

features.title: Gallery, v-card, service feedback viewers
features.summary: Specialized renderers for media, contact card, and feedback forms.
features.content:
## Components

`GalleryViewerComponent`, `VcardViewerComponent`, `ServiceFeedbackViewerComponent` — each aligns with its wizard JSON schema.

features.title: Public vs authenticated viewers
features.summary: Some routes use AuthGuard or hide layout for admin-only flows.
features.content:
## Routing

Compare `data: { hideLayout: true }` on loyalty registration detail vs public viewer routes. Use **GetQRPublic** when no session exists.

features.title: Scan tracking
features.summary: ScanQR and history endpoints power dashboards.
features.content:
## Analytics

`ScanQR` may fire on open. `GetQRScansHistory` supports owner analytics views.
